original_method: Validate a reviewed copy of the SGEMM configuration, execute one RVS/GST pass with full periodic output and per-GPU telemetry, then compare completion/error evidence to the approved platform specification.

Preserve full evidence and verify return to idle

review_improvement: Corrects a cross-case FRU contamination and read-only misclassification while preserving every SGEMM parameter and complete stress evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The command alone cannot rescue a review whose package and oracle belong to FRU. SGEMM with device-all and target stress 100000 is active load; each GPU can fail or throttle independently even if the process exits zero. Exact config identity, full RVS output and per-device health are therefore necessary, while the completed row152 must be skipped rather than counted twice.
